subject: Trial velocity checks, mutual action map & sticky actions
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Hart <sophie.hart@velociti.ai>, Procurement <procurement@velociti.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call recap + mutual action map (MAM) draft and velocity checklist

Hi Sophie / Velociti team —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a tight mutual action map so we keep momentum on the 4-week trial. I've attached a short checklist (MAM-velocity-checklist.xlsx) and a diagram for trial topology. Please review and confirm owners/dates by Wednesday.

High-level success criteria (what you asked for):
- 80% intent-classification accuracy on the Customer Support dataset (sample provided)
- <200ms median latency for 512-token requests in your us-east-1 test region
- End-to-end document-to-answer throughput of 50 queries/min during peak window

Evaluation plan (how we'll measure it):
- Redwood will run a validation harness daily against the Supplied Sample (owner: Redwood)
- Velociti to provide a 10k-row labeled subset by 2027-08-12 (owner: Sophie)
- Telemetry: latency & token-cost dashboards (Redwood to provision access)

Proposed timeline & ownership (4-week trial):
- Week 0 (setup, by 2027-08-13): infra provision + sample data ingest (owners: Redwood ops / Sophie)
- Week 1 (baseline eval): baseline metrics, basic fine-tune/adapter test (owners: Redwood/Velociti ML)
- Week 2 (stress & integration): peak traffic run, latency tuning, RBAC checks (owners: Redwood infra / Velociti Eng)
- Week 3 (value validation): usage patterns & business metrics alignment, exec readout prep (owners: Sophie / Velociti PM)

Open asks for Velociti today:
1) Confirm the labeled sample delivery date (we need it by 2027-08-12)
2) Provide the procurement contact who will handle the trial PO and any paperwork
3) Confirm whether data retention needs to be short-lived (30 days) or archived for the trial

Attachments referenced: [Attachment: MAM-velocity-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)], [Attachment: trial-setup-diagram.png (png)]

Next steps (please action):
- Sophie: confirm sample delivery date + procurement contact (reply by 2027-08-11)
- Velociti: approve MAM checklist (comment inline on the Drive doc)
- Ben (cc'd): I'll need a quick pre-provision call with your infra lead if retention needs HSM/KMS integration

Thanks — aiming to start provisioning Tuesday if we get signoff.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

---
From: Sophie Hart <sophie.hart@velociti.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@velociti.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + mutual action map (MAM) draft and velocity checklist

Thanks Avery — great summary.

Quick answers: we can deliver the 10k labeled subset by 2027-08-12 as requested. Procurement contact is procurement@velociti.ai (cc'd). For the trial, we prefer 30-day retention unless Redwood requires longer for evaluation metrics, in which case we can discuss a short-term archive.

Two small asks from our side: 
- Can you include a sample payload for the latency test (512-token request) so our infra knows the request format?
- On success criteria, could we add a qualitative NPS-style question for agent satisfaction after Week 2? not blocking but helpful for our PM.

I'll route this to our infra lead and procurement; expect formal PO conversation after we validate the baseline.

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 11:05:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Post-call recap + mutual action map (internal prep)

Avery / Ben —

Quick internal checklist before we provision:
- Ben: can you confirm we have a 1-node test pool in us-east-1 pre-quantized model we can load? ETA 2027-08-13 EOD. If not, what's the blocker?
- Ben: please prepare the latency test payload sample (JSON) and upload to the Drive folder linked in the MAM. Sophie asked for that.
- I will schedule a 30-min pre-provision call with Velociti infra for 2027-08-13 16:00 UTC. Avery, can you send the invite?

Ben replied (internal):
> We have capacity but need to refresh the quantized image. Should be done by tomorrow noon. I'll push the latency payload sample now.

I also toggled the retention config to 30 days for the trial environment as Velociti requested; if they later ask for archive we can enable short-term archive during Week 1.

Laura
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Hart <sophie.hart@velociti.ai>, Procurement <procurement@velociti.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 10:22:00 -0400
Subject: Weekly status nudge — outstanding items & next steps (Velociti trial)

Hi Sophie / procurement — quick status note and nudge so we stay on the 4-week plan. Current state: provisioning underway; ben confirmed quantized image refresh; retention set to 30 days.

Outstanding items from Velociti:
1) Procurement PO approval or confirmation of trial terms (we need estimated PO or email OK to start provisioning fully) — owner: procurement@velociti.ai — target: 2027-08-18
2) Final labeled data drop (10k rows) — owner: Sophie — expected by 2027-08-12 (we have partial sample; please confirm if remaining is delayed)
3) Confirmation on the Week-2 agent-satisfaction question (Sophie): we'll include an optional survey; let us know question wording if you want it customized

If procurement can confirm the PO by Wednesday we can keep the Week 1 baseline and Week 2 stress tests on schedule.

Next steps we are taking this week (Redwood):
- Ben: run baseline eval Monday night and post preliminary metrics to the Drive folder
- Laura: host 30-min pre-provision call Tuesday 16:00 UTC (invite follows)
- Avery: I'll prepare the exec readout template for Week 3 and share by Friday

Please reply with PO status or any blockers. Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best regards,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142
